profile_text.body:
Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. It trades under the ticker GOOGL and its website is abc.xyz, which the company presents as its investor relations home. Its filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission are registered under CIK 0001652044.

The material available does not list any specific products, so no product-level description can be given here. The company's own site text is limited to the investor relations landing page.

On the legal side, litigation records associated with Alphabet list 281 matters in California. No other cases, and no MCP servers, are recorded.
